settings: Open & test → Adjust → hall / gallery · recipe controls. Connection controls set passage width and height. In the engine HUD, Living architecture → Find connection ports previews targets, then Connect and align. Detach keeps the current position. Floor reflections are enabled. Recipe input.handle binds an axis and numeric local origin to an existing bounded input. It is a value guide, not a guarantee of silhouette fit. Other controls remain sliders.
limits: Explicit directed ports, not global welding. Entry targets must come from real wall opening exports. The consumer connector is a root typed anchor with input-only pose and dimensions; no nested, context-dependent or repeated from port. Entry/wall fit compares width and height; floor/support fit compares width and depth. The target is not enlarged automatically. Preview checks interfaces and cycles; estimate also checks geometry, roof contact and overrides. Detach before moving a constrained consumer. No automatic obstacle routing or arbitrary mesh Boolean. Gold guides preview proposed values; geometry rebuilds and validates only on release. Input handles use numeric local origins, so they do not automatically follow other recipe dimensions. Move/Rotate are disabled for attached roots. No general Boolean, obstacle route finder or global layout solver.
prompt: Create a detailed Japanese temple garden with procedural materials, repeated shared geometry and reflected stone floors. Keep building composition in declarative recipes. Add useful bounded input.handle controls for the hall roof rise and doorway width, and the gallery width, length and passage height. Expose the Constructions HUD. Inspect bindings, preview connections and estimate changes. Preserve stable IDs, overrides and existing content. Save and reopen the full scene.
try: Pause, then Open construction handles → hall → Shape. Drag a gold ruler; release to apply or Escape to cancel.
Select gallery by its base dot, or choose it in Constructions. Shape controls stay available while its root remains attached.
Choose Move on hall to move the source and its dependent gallery together. Detach a consumer explicitly before moving it freely.
Adjust retains every numeric recipe slider. Save my scene keeps handle declarations, values and connections.
steps: Open & test; pause playback before editing.
Open construction handles. Choose Shape, Move or Rotate in the Constructions HUD.
Click a base dot to select; drag a gold handle and release once. A refusal preserves the last valid building.
Use Adjust for variants, precise numeric controls and connection tools. Save an independent .scene.
title: A garden you can shape.
summary: Recipe-authored gold handles reshape a connected temple and gallery. Move a source, retain its doorway and roof links, and save your own edition.

browser_validation.scope: Integrated Chromium/WebGPU: three variants, recipe handle metadata, validated source edits, attached-root refusal and fresh-engine complete document reload; browser pointer shape and move edits. Native films verify animation separately.
